cross_verification.note: Extensive search could not locate a functioning official Union of the Comoros government domain with passport photo specifications. egouv.km (the Comoros e-government portal) refused all connections (both http and https); ambassade-comores.com (Comoros Embassy Paris) reset the connection; no working '.km' Ministry of Foreign Affairs or immigration-directorate site was found. The only reachable official Comoros government page located was the Permanent Mission of the Union of the Comoros to the UN (un.int/comoros), which describes the passport/visa fee schedule and required documents but states no photo size, background, or composition rules. Third-party aggregator sites disagree with each other even on basic points like background colour (some say plain white; one French-language aggregator claims white is prohibited and light blue/grey is required, attributing this to unnamed 'ISO/IEC standards') — this contradiction is itself a reason to leave the field unverified rather than adopt any single aggregator's figure, per the truthfulness gate.
